entry.title: Pashupatinath Temple

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the principal pagoda and its four mapped roof/body/finial records. Preserve every independent building, trimming the guard at any native overlap.

terrainReference.basis: Retain the unchanged161-square/6m standard Mapzen-USGS grid and1312.132m reference datum. Set the small platform top just above the maximum standard DEM sample inside the actual mapped footprint. Local foundation feet extend50cm below their terrain samples. Steps remain inside the platform. No ground or water excavation is requested; detailed archaeological floor levels are not surveyed.

entry.note: Standard PMTiles building35185285259147 is also the named Pashupatinath Temple POI. Its four-point platform and four independently mapped roof/body/finial parts identify the principal shrine. Preserve raw east/south coordinates and the square grid axis at37.66 degrees south of east. Four door faces are treated symmetrically; the separate eastern precinct gate is not confused with the main shrine. Reviewed approximate full-site contact on the unchanged161-square/6m standard DEM. The small platform top clears the maximum terrain sample inside the actual mapped footprint; local foundation feet extend50cm below terrain samples. No ground or water excavation is requested. Loading replaces five principal-shrine records and preserves1612 independent buildings in the960m tile exactly. Three native water features retain57903.0123 square metres. Failure retains all1617 tile buildings; eviction preserves both surfaces and frees geometry. A synthetic16m partial tile retains original terrain around and beneath clipped model pieces; its empty semantic context verifies clipping/lifecycle, not neighboring replacement. Temporary cut faces are not permanent shrine geometry. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
